items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Although he missed playing with John, he did perform with Paul, George and Ringo.

ctx.x: English guitarist Laurence Juber was born on November 12, 1952 and was playing gigs at age 13. He fulfilled his ambition of becoming a studio musician by becoming a first-call guitarist in London and L.A. Acoustic Guitar magazine has named him one of the top fingerstyle guitarists of all time. Although he missed playing with John, he did perform with Paul, George and Ringo.
Laurence was interviewed in Glasgow, Scotland on July 27, 2016, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
